<# How the finding was confirmed: the test results linked to it (evidence
   records whose outcome is "finding") — the tool, the system, when and by
   whom, the command as it was run and an excerpt of what came back.  Expects
   `confirmations` (f.confirmations) and `f`.  Included only when the list is
   not empty; the template opts in with "evidence_records": true in
   template.json, and reports issued before the list existed do not carry it.

   The tool, system, date, person and summary are printed values: escaped.
   The command and the output are tool text and go through code(): the
   filter builds a verbatim block from the string in data.json.  NEVER print
   either as a value between backticks or inside a fence — escapes are not
   undone there, and a fence in the text would end yours. #>
<% for c in confirmations %>

**<< c.tool or "Test" >>** against << c.host >><% if c.date %>, << c.date >><% endif %><% if c.by %>, by << c.by >><% endif %>

<% if c.summary %>
<< c.summary >>

<% endif %>
<% if c.command %>
Command:
<< code(c, "command") >>
<% endif %>
<% if c.output %>
Output<% if c.output_truncated %> (excerpt)<% endif %>:
<< code(c, "output") >>
<% endif %>
<% endfor %>
<% if f.get("confirmations_omitted") %>

*<< f.confirmations_omitted >> further test result(s) confirming this finding are not printed.*

<% endif %>
